slot_scores.name: purchase_at_month_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: In a given month, is the sequence "buy first, then sell" (so you can sell units you just bought that same month), or "sell first, then buy" (so you can only sell from stock carried in from before)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the within-month sequence of purchases and sales, which resolves the timing of purchases relative to sales.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only hidden slot, H1, was resolved by the agent's question in turn 10 before READY_TO_MODEL; no P0 or P1 slots remained unresolved.

summary: The agent conducted a thorough clarification interview, explicitly resolving the hidden purchase-timing issue and several other modeling details before stopping. No material hidden slots were left unresolved.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
